tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i khrid rgyun

man ngag snang brnyan kun 'char gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badzra bhai ra wā ya/ grangs med rgyal ba'i ye shes phung po ma lus gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje gdul phyir gtum drag khros pa'i gar mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan dus dgra'i dbang po gang dang dbyer med kun mkhyen tsong kha pa/ /dus rnams kun tu bdag snying dbus rol 'bral med rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lung rtogs chos/ /thub bstan rnam rgyal khang bzang rtser bzung nas/ /skal ldan legs bris gzhon nu'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dbugs 'byin bshes gnyen lha dbang yongs la 'dud/ /gsang chen mthar thug bla med rgyud kun gyi/ /gtso bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed po yi/ /rgyud rgyal snying po rim pa dang po'i lam/ /dam pa'i gsung la brten nas 'dir bshad bya/ /de la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i rnam gzhag bshad pa la gnyis/ spyi'i rnam gzhag mdor bstan pa dang*/ skabs don bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong nyid la rtse gcig tu gnyis snang gi spros pa zhi ba'i sgo nas mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgrib bral lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang*/ rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i bzhin lag gi rnam pa can gyi sku gnyis ngo bo dbyer mi byed par zung du 'jug pa'i rgyal ba'i go 'phang ni/ bla med kyi rgyud dag gi brjod bya'i gtso bo dang*/ de'i gdul bya'i thob bya mthar thug yin zhing*/ de yang gzhi dus na sems can la shin tu phra ba'i gnyug ma'i lus sems gnyis yod pa la brten nas sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /de la gnyug ma'i sems dang lus ji lta bu zhe na bsdus te brjod na/ dang po sems de ni/ rang nyid mngon du gyur pa'i tshe spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa lta bu'i yul snang can/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la thog ma med pa nas skad cig kyang rgyun ma chad par rjes su zhugs pa/

rang gi ngo bo dri ma'i rang bzhin du ma skyes pa'i gsal rig shin tu dag pa/ rkyen las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur na ni ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i gnas su skye yang*/ thabs mkhas khyad par can dang ldan na rang 'bras sangs rgyas kyi yon tan kyang bskyed nus pa'o/ /rang gi ngo bo la dri ma'i bslad pa ma zhugs pa sogs kyang dper na/ gser bzang po ni g.ya' sogs dang bcas pa'i tshe rang gi ngo bo ni g.ya' sogs dang ma 'dres shing*/ gzhan gyis 'byed nus pa dang/ de bzhin du chu ni rnyog pa dang bcas na'ang rang ngos nas de dang 'bral rung ba dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od dang rlung ni gtsang mi gtsang gang la reg kyang rang ngos nas de dang ma 'dres shing 'bral rung yin la/ de dag gi skyon yon dang re zhig 'brel yang ngo bo ni de dag gi rkyen gyis bsgyur mi nus pa ltar/ gnyug ma'i sems phra ba ni/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i tshe yang dri ma'i rang bzhin du ma skyes shing dri ma dang 'bral rung du gnas pa zhig ste 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi dus su mngon du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa phra ba'i lus ni/ shin tu phra ba'i sems de dang ngo bo gcig cing de'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung shin tu phra ba ste sems de dang 'bral mi rung du gnas pa'o/ /sgrub gzhi de lta bu la brten nas thob pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug zung 'jug gi go 'phang dang*/ de thob byed kyi lam dang bcas pa ni/ rdzogs par rdo rje 'chang gis bla med kyi rgyud las gsungs kyi/ gzhan rgyud sde 'og ma rnams dang*/ thun mong pa'i mdo sde las ni ma bshad do/ /sbyir bla med pa rgyud la'ang bye ba drug yod kyang*/ 'dir gshin rje gshed kyi dbang du byas na/ de ltar ston pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtsa rgyud rgyas pa sho lo ka 'bum yod pa ni/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul na yod kyang*/ 'phags bod kyi yul du ma 'gyur la slob dpon lā li tas rgyud rgyas pa las byung ba ni da lta rtog bdun du grags pa 'di nyid do/

/bshad rgyud ni/ rtog gsum du grags pa ste/ 'di yang rtsa rgyud nas bshad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad gsal bar 'chad pa zhig go /sbyir gshin rje gshed la dmar nag 'jigs gsum yod cing*/ de yang 'jam dpal nyid cung zad khros pas dgra nagaches khros pas gshed dmar/ shin tu khros pas 'jigs byed de/ de dag gi rgyud kyang bla med pha rgyud kyi sder gtogs la/ sgrub thabs kyi skor yang*/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ ro langs brgyad skor/ bcu gsum ma/ zhe dgu ma sogs yod do/ /de rnams gang nyams su blangs na 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin yang*/ lhag par 'jigs byed la bsten nas des rjes su 'dzin par gsungs pas na/ 'dir 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang du byas te 'chad par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la gsum/ thun gyi thog mar ji ltar bya ba/ dngos gzhi la ji ltar bya ba/ mjug dang thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rdor dril dang nang mchod byin gyis brlab tshul/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ji ltar bya tshul/ bdag bskyed mchod pa byin gyis brlab tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su mchod rdzas dang bris sku sogs 'tshaugs par byas nas/ ro gdan du bsams pa'i stan bde ba la kha lhor phyogs pa'am/ der phyogs par mos te/ gshin rje gshed kyi bla rgyud gsol 'debs sngon du btang la/ thog mar lhar gsal 'debs pa'i tshe/ rang gi phung po 'di phra rags ma phye bar stod smad nas rim gyis 'od du zhu bar bsam/ de'i tshe bdag dang phung po sogs kyi chos ni brten nas btags pa las gzhan du rang bzhin gyis med do snyam du stong nyid kyi lta ba dran par byed cing mnyam par bzhagastong pa'i ngang las rang gi phung po rnying po'i go sa der sna tshogs padma phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar/ me rlung gnyis ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan nagalte ba ljang*/ ze'u 'bru ser ba zhig thol gyis byung bar bsam/

de'i steng du lte ba dang mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs me shel gyi maṇḍal lta bu dmar 'khyil le ba zhig byung bar bsam/ la lar sna tshogs padma'i sngon du 'od sngon po khru gdab sogs ci rigs bsam par bshad pa bzhin byas kyang rung ngo*/ /nyi dkyil gyi steng du chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du rang gi sems bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gnas pa yongs su 'gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nagarwa sngon po rnon po gnyis dang ldan pa/ ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sbom zhing thung la bsus pa 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stobs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug cing zhal nas khrag rgyun 'dzag pa/ shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub pa/ rab tu bgrad pa'i spyan gsum nyi ma ltar 'bar ba/ smin ma dang rdzi ma dang sma ra me ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes shing phyag gnyis kyi mthil khrag rlon gyis byugs pa lta bu/ phyag sen rnams lcags kyu ltar rno zhing ring ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'o/ /yum ro langs ma sngon mo gcer bu khro mo'i zhal can/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yon pas yab kyi brla'i steng du 'khril zhing g.yas brkyang ba/ gnyis ka'i sku las 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur sgor gyis 'phro ba'i rtse mor ye shes kyi me drag tu 'bar ba/ thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ yab rus pa'i rgyan drug dang yum phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa sogs dang ldan zhing dwangs shing gsal ba la nga rgyal bzhag go /'dir rang nyid lhar bskyed pa'i dgos pa yod de/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i nang mchod sogs byin gyis brlab pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/

de ni tha mal gyi snang zhen dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mi nus pas/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir dogs pa cung zad dpyad na/ kha cig 'di snyam du 'dir 'jigs byed dngos ma yin bzhin du dngos yin no snyam du 'dzin cing bsgom par mi rung ste/ de ltar 'dzin pa'i blo de log shes su 'gyur ba'i phyir zhe na/ dogs pa de ni skabs 'di 'drar ma zad/ gzhan du'ang skye bas lan 'debs shes na khyad che'o/ /des na skabs 'di lta bu'i tshe blo de rtog pa yin yang log shes su mi 'gyur te dus der dngos po'i gnas tshod la lha de dngos yin par mi 'dzin gyi mos pa'i khyad par gyis re zhig lha de dngos so snyam du nga rgyal 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa tsam ni/ mchod pa de dang de dngos ma yin bzhin du dngos su mos nas phul chog pa dang*/ mdun du tshogs zhing du bzhugs pa'i sku brnyan nam/ de yang med kyang sangs rgyas byang sems sogs dngos su bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas chog pa ni/ mdo sngags gnyis ka nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de'i tshe dngos po'i gnas tshod la yang lha de dngos yin par 'dzin na/ blo de log shes su 'gyur te/ de'i tshe lha dngos yin min tsam yang legs par ma phyed pa'i rmongs pa chen pos lha ma yin pa'ang lhar zhen pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs 'dir ma zad/ bskyed rim mthar phyin nas lha'i gsal snang brtan pa'i tshe/ lha'i nga rgyal bcos min du 'byung yang de'i tshe lha de nyid dngos yin snyam du mos mno tsam ma yin par dngos gnas su lha der 'dzin zhing khas len rigs pa ni ma yin te/ dri med 'od las/ bsgom pa'i dbang gis phung po 'on kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam nyams pa de ni log pa'i nga rgyal gyis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur na/ bdag rdo rje sems dpa' stobs bcu pa'o zhes de ltar rlom par byed do/ /'di ni stobs bcu pa ma yin te/

stobs bcu pa'i 'gal zla nyi tshe ba rmongs pa chen po'o/ /'dir rnal 'byor pa 'di'i sangs rgyas ni sngon med pa shin tu rmad du byung ba chen po ste/ sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs shidangos min kyang de'i tshe de dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal byed pa mi 'gal te/ de ltar tha mal gyi snang zhen bkag nas mchog gi snang zhen byas pas dgos pa khyad par can du ma 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par ni gzhan du shes dgos la/ mos pa'i khyad par ram rten 'brel gyi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ tshul der rtog ge tsam gyis rigs pas gnod pa mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rdor dril byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul ni gzhung ltar la/ mtshon don ni rdo rjes thabs kyi cha thams cad dang dril bus shes rab kyi cha thams cad mtshon la/ rdor dril gnyis kas don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems mtshon no/ /yang rang lhar bskyed pa sku'i dam tshig dang*/ rdo rje thugs dang*/ dril bu gsung dang*/ rang lha yab yum du bsgom pa phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste de rnams dran pa'i sgo nas rdor dril bzung bar bya'o/ /de nas nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul la bzhi/ bsang ba/ sbyang ba/ bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ hrīḥṣt+rīḥ brjod pa dang mnyam du rang gi snying ga nas rang 'dra'i gshin rje gshed yab rkyang dpag tu med pa spros te/ nang mchod kyi sgrub gzhi la gnas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams sprin nag rlung gis 'das pa bzhin du rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ swā bhā wa'i sngags brjod pa'i sgo nas sngags de'i don 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dran par byas te stong par spyang bar bya la/ de'i dgos pa ni tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyong ba dang*/ mchod rdzas bde stong gi rnam rol du 'char ba'i ched do/ /gsum pa bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ yig sngon po zhig thol gyis byung ba 'od du mer gyis zhu ba las/

rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ bcad kha rang dang sgor mo phar bstan pa/ mchog ma gnyis su bum pa nas 'thon pa'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram las me dkyil dmar po zur gsum pa zur gcig rang la bstan pa me 'bar bzhin pa/ de'i zur gsum gyi steng du ā dmar po'am dkar po re re/ de yongs su gyur pa las mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi ltag pa dbus su bstan pa'i 'dzoms su āḥdakar po snga ma las cung che ba las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dbus yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga 'god tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang*/ 'dir nang gi shar lho nub byang dbus su rim pa bzhin du mtshon bya rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rim pa bzhin du/ bhrūṃ/ aṃ/ dziṃ/ khaṃ/ hūṃ las byung zhing*/ bdag gi bla ma mkhas pa kha cig sbyang gzhi'i dbang du mdzad nas ngo bo rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa gti mug nga rgyal ser sna 'dod chags phrag dog zhe sdang rnams rim bzhin yin pa la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ram/ kha cig 'di la klan ka 'tshol 'dug pas yang na sbyi 'gro ltar ngo bo ye shes yin pa la rnam pa yang*/ khyi/ glang chen/ rta/ mi'i sha rnams tshang ma'am gtub pa gang rung*/ mtshon byed ming yig dang po rim bzhin go ku da ha na yig gis mtshan par bskyed do/ /yang shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ byang shar/ dbus dang lngar rim bzhin/ mtshon bya spyan ma/ ma mā ki gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma/ ro langs lnga'i sa bon rim par laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ raṃ lnga las byung zhing*/ ngo bo rang rgyud kyis chu me rlung nam mkha' dang rnam shes kyi khams rnams sam/ yang na ngo bo ye shes yin pa la rnam pa dri chen rakta byang sems dkar po rkang mar/ dri chu dang*/ mtshon byed ming yig dang po ba ri shu ma mū rnams kyis mtshan par bskyed do/

/de yang sbyang gzhi dang sbyar na rang rgyud kyi rlung las yaṃ dang*/ rang rgyud kyi drod las raṃ ste de gnyis las rlung gi dkyil dang me dkyil bskyed pa'am/ ye shes las bskyed pa gang rung ngo me rlung gi sa bon stong pa'i ngang las byung ba ni stong nyid kyi rnam 'phrul du blta ba dang*/ sa bon las bskyed pa ni ming rkyang btags yod du bstan pa nyid mtshon te gzhan la'ang 'gre/ rlung dkyil gyi 'og rlung thur ser/ mes gtum mo/ /mi mgo gsum gyis lus ngag yid gsum thod pa'i rdzas kyis sbyi bo'i byang sems rnams mtshon no/ / skabs 'dir thod pa rdzas kyi snod du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ thod pa'i skad dod ka pā la zhes pa bde skyong la 'jug pas bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /thod pa bde skyong gi snod yin te/ bde ba chen po'i rten du kunda lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems ni sbyi bo'i rtsa 'khor na gnas pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig thod pa phyi dkar bas khams dkar po dang bde ba/ nang dmar bas khams dmar po dang stong pa mtshon par 'dod la gzhan dag de las ldog ste mtshon par yang bzhed de mi 'gal/ dkar dmar gyis ni khams dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod dang*/ thod pa dum bu gcig pa dang tshang bas ni bde stong dbyer med mtshon no/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rdzas su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mtshon don sngar bzhin dang*/ sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum byas nas rang nyid kyis longs spyod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul bas dngos grub myur du 'gug pas lcags kyu lnga dang*/ dngos grub thams cad gsal bar byed pas sgron ma lnga zhes kyang brjod pa'i phyir/ dri chen sogs lnga der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de lnga lus zung gi dwangs ma yin pas/

sbyangs rtogs spar gsum byas nas longs spyod cing phul bas/ rang nyid la 'chi med kyi go 'phang ster ba'i rten 'brel yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir sha lnga gshegs pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga gshegs pa yum lnga'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nas mos dgos te/ sa bon gyi bskyed tshul las dang*/ phyogs mtshams su 'god tshul las 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la mtshan pa'i yi ge de dag ni ba lang sogs kyi ming yig dang po yin te/ gau ba ni ba lang*/ ku ku ra ni khyi/ daṇḍi n-i so ldan te glang po/ /ha ya ni rta/ na ra ni mi ste de rnams kyi dang po dang*/ yang*/ bi ṭa bshad pa/ rakta khragashū tra byang sems te khu ba/ mant+ra rkang mar/ mū ṭa gcin rnams kyi ming yig dang po yin pa'i phyir/ ming yig rnams ni 'greng ste gnas shing*/ de dag gi bar snang la steng du oṃ dkar po/ de'i 'og tu āḥdamar po/ de'i 'og tu hūṃ sngon po'o/ /kha cig yi ge gsum de las ldog ste gnas par yang bshad/ bzhi pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rlung dkyil ba dan dang bcas pa la phog pas/ ba dan g.yob/ rlung g.yos/ me rab tu 'bar nas thod pa gdungs te rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa yi ge gsum la phog pas/ de gsum las rim pa bzhin du 'od zer 'phros pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams bkug nas yi ge gsum la rim par thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid du bsam/ yi ge gsum yang mas rim nas thod par lhung ste g.yas skor du lan gsum gsum dkrugs pa'i mthar zhu bas/ hūṃ gis rdzas kyi kha dog ngan pa dri mi zhim pa nus pa dman pa'i skyon sbyangs nas dwangs shing sngo ba'i rang bzhin can du byas par bsam/ āḥs bdud rtsi kha dog dmar ser gyi rnam par ram sngo dmar gyi rnam par bsgyur/ oṃ gyis bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du mang por spel zhing kha dog dkar dmar du bsgyur ba'i mos pa byed pa'am/

yang na kha dog dmar ser nyid du gnas par byas kyang mi 'gal/ ngag tu yi ge gsum lan gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo/ /de la bskyed pa ni/ dam tshig pa'i rdzas sam bdud rtsi yin la/ rdo rje gsum bkug nas bstim pa ni ye shes pa'i bdud rtsi 'jug pa'o/ /'dir khrid rgyun 'ga' zhig tu lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib rnams kyang thod pa'i bdud rtsir thim par mos pa'i tshul bshad la/ kha cig ni de 'gog pa snang ste brtagaganyis pa sngon 'gro'i mchod pa ji ltar bya ba ni/ nang mchod 'thor ba dang mnyam du'am min kyang las sngags brjod de/ bsangs pa dang sbyangs pa ni nang mchod kyi skabs ltar byas la/ bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su āḥ dkar po brgyad tshar bcu drug gam tshar gcig 'phreng byas nas 'greng ba 'od du zhu ba las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba de'i grangs ldan/ de dag gi nang du bde stong gi ye shes kyi cha hūṃ yig sngon po re re 'greng stabs su byung bar bsam/ de rnams zhu ba las ngo bo ye shes de nyid la rnam pa g.yon nas brtsams te/ 'dir drag po'i dbang du byas na/ dgra bgegs kyi snying khrag gi mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil/ snying khrag gis bsgos pa'i dri chab/ dbang po'i me tog sha chen dang tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ thod rnga dang rkang gling gi rol mo ste/ mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can/ byed las mgron rnams kyi mig sogs dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ 'khrid yig kha cig tu ngo bo lha dang mi'i yo byad de dang de phun sum tshogs pa yin pa la zhes kyang 'byung ngo*/ /de nas oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs kyis rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlab bo/ /sngon 'gro'i gtor ma byin brlab ni/

gtor ma la dmigs te bsang sbyang bskyed pa ni/ nang mchod kyi skabs ltar ro/ /gtor mgron ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa thogs pa bcu drug spros te/ phyogs skyong gsal 'debs rgyas par byed na/ oṃ hrīḥṣt+rīḥ zhes sogs brjod cing bka' bsgo la/ sngags don ni/ 'phrog byed mche ba rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal can/ ma rungs ba dbang po la sogs pa 'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa myur du khug cig ces pa'o/ /hrīḥ ni 'phrog byed/ ṣt+rīḥmache ba/ wi kri ta rnam par 'gyur ba/ a na na gdong ngam zhal/ oṃ ni mgo 'dren dang hūṃ dang phaṭa ni bskul ba dang*/ sarba ni thams cad/ duṣtaṃ ni ma rungs pa/ ind+ra dbang po/ ā di na 'di dag sa pā ri wā ra 'khor bcas/ ā karṣa ya dza ni myur du khug gcig go /spros pa'i khro bo de dag las shar dang lho dang byang dang 'og tu gnyis gnyis dang mtshams bzhi dang nub rnams su re re steng du gsum rnams song bas/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te bkug nas rang dang gtor ma'i phyog mtshams rnams su 'khod par bsams la/ de yang*/ shar du dbang po/ /de'i g.yon du nye dbang*/ lhor chos rgyal 'khor bcas/ de'i g.yon du gshin rje/ nub tu chu bdag byang du gnod sbyin/ de'i g.yon du tshogs bdag byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ dbang po'i g.yas su zla ba/ nye dbang gi g.yon du nyi ma/ de dag gi rgyab tu tshangs pa/ 'og tu'am chu lha'i g.yas su sa'i lha mo/ /g.yon du thag bzang ris rnams kha nang du phyogs pa/ mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de nas khro bo rnams rang gi snying khar bsdu/ slar yang khro bo phur bu thogs pa bcu drug spros te/ sngags brjod cing sngags don gzhan 'dra ba la/ kī la ya ni phur bu thob cig ces pa'o/

khro bo de dag gis phyogs skyong rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar phur bu btab pas/ grub pa brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi ril bu'i bcud len grub na/ rgas khog gi lus kyang gzhon lus ltar 'gyur zhing*/ kha dog gser ltar 'ong ba de bzhin du 'dir yang*/ phur bus reg pas skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed yum bcas su gyur pa'i rigs bdag tu'ang 'jigs byed yum bcas re bzhugs par bsam/ de ni rgyas pa'i dbang du byas la/ lhar bskyed pa ni tha mal gyi snang zhen bkag nas lha'i 'khor lor 'char ba'i ched do/ /gzhan 'gugs sngags brjod nas bkug ste gsal 'debs rgyas par mi byed par lhar bskyed pa ni 'bring*/ sngags kyang mi brjod par 'od zer tsam gyis bkug nas lhar bskyed pa ni bsdus pa ste/ rgyun pa'i mngon rtogs la ni gtor 'bul ma byas kyang mi 'gal/ mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar po 'od kyi spu gu can rnams su gyur par bsams la/ rang gi snying kha nas lha mo ro rdo rje ma thod pa thogs pa bcu drug spros te/ rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod pa dang mnyam du lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi nas phud bcus te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs skad cig gis gsal ba la phul bas bzhes nas mgron rnams sha khrag gi gtor ma la longs spyod pa'i gnang ba byin par bsams la/ lha mo rnams kyis slar yang bdud rtsi bcus nas mgron rnams la 'bul bar bsam/ gtor sngags kyi don/ sngags tshan dang po bdun gyi oṃ la sogs bdun ni oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa zhes pa ste/ lhag ma bdun ni gshin rje 'khor bcas kyi ming dang spel ba yin la/ dgos pa ni de dag gi rgyud byin gyis brlob pa'i ched do/ /bhu tsa ra ni/ sa la spyod pa chos rgyal nang sgrub 'khor bcas/ pā ta la tsa ra ni sa 'og na spyod pa ste tsa muṇḍi 'khor bcas/ khe tsa ra ya ni mkha' la spyod pa ste dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas/

pū ra wa naṃ ga naṃ n-i shar du gnas pa ste zhi ba'i gshin rje dkar po 'khor bcas/ dakṣi na di ka ya ni lho phyogs pa ste rgyas pa'i gshin rje ser po 'khor bcas/ pañtsi ma ni nub phyogs pa ste dbang gi gshin rje dmar po 'khor bcas/ utta ra di ga ya ni byang phyogs pa ste drag po'i gshin rje sngon po 'khor bcas la phul bar bsam/ oṃ i sogs kyi hrīḥṣt+rīḥ sogs bcu ni las sngags kyi yi ge dang*/ i sogs ni phyogs skyong gi ming yig dang po spel ba ste/ dgos pa ni sngar bzhin no/ /de yang i ni ind+ra ste dbang po'i ming yig dang po/ de bzhin du ya ni ya ma ste gshin rje'i/ wa ni wa ru ṇa ste chu lha'i/ kṣe ni ya kṣe ste gnod sbyin gyi ming yig tha ma/ ko ni ko'u shi ka ste brgya byin gyi/ e ni e dha ne ste me lha'i/ a ni a sha sa ste/ khrag thung ngam/ a bhi rakṣa ste mngon par srung ba srin po'i/ de ni de wa ba yu ste rlung lha'i ming yig dang po/ bhyo ni sa ste sa'i lha mo/ sarba thams cad te phyogs rnams la sbyar/ bhu te bhyaḥni/ 'byung po rnams te de dag gi 'khor du 'ongs pa'i 'byung po rnams la'ang 'bul lo/ /slar yang spros pa'i tsartsi ka la sogs pas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ da sha sogs kyis mchod/ de yang*/ da sha ni bcu/ dikka ni phyogs/ lo ka ni 'jig rten/ pā la skyong ba/ sa pā ri wā ra 'khor dang bcas pa/ arghaṃ ni mchod yon/ pra tītstsha ni so sor bzhes shig hūṃ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs zhes pa ste/ de bzhin du shapta'i bar la rigs 'gre/ de nas nang mchod kyang phul la/ bcom ldan chos rje sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi spyi bo'i rigs bdag gi thugs kar gshin rje gshed kyis yig brgyas bskor bar bsams la/ de'i yig brgya brjod cing lhag chad bskang*/ rigs bdag gi thugs ka'i yig brgya las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad dag par bsams par 'khrid 'ga' zhig las byung yang*/

'dir yig brgya brjod pa ni lhag chad gso ba'i ched du yin pas/ dmigs pa de ltar byas tshe mgron gyi nyes pa dag pa'i ched du byas par song bas dpyod/ bzod gsol byas nas rang gnas su gshegs te sgrub pa po'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched du rang phyogs su 'khod par bsam mo/ /'di la'ang rang dang nye ba'i phyogs mtshams su 'khod par bzhed pa dang*/ phyogs skyong rang rang gi bzhugs gnas su 'khod par 'dod pa'i tshul gnyis so/ /gsum pa bdag bskyed mchod pa ni/ mchod 'go rang gi g.yas phyogs nas brtsams pa ma gtogs byin rlabs kyi skabs sngar bzhin dang 'on kyang brgyad tshar ni rgyas par na lha grangs dang mnyam pa'o/ /slob dpon khri chen blo bzang dar rgyas zhal snga nas ni/ 'di ltar/ 'khrid rgyun la med cing sgrub thabs dang mi mthun pa'i bdag bskyed 'ba' zhig gi tshe 'bul ba'i yul gang yang med bzhin du phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi maṇḍal 'bul ba'i khrid byed pa ni rje'i dgongs pa dang 'gal bar bshad pas/ de ltar mdzad pa ni 'khrid rgyun 'ga' zhig tu snang mod/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs lta bu yin na ma gtogs/ bdag bskyed kyi mngon rtogs rkyang pa'i skabs su 'dir maṇḍal gyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa ni mi rung ba e yin ma shes kyang*/ cho ga'i rnam dbye dod par byas tshe 'bul mi dgos pa yang bden par mngon no/ /de ltar cho ga gzhan la yang 'gre bas/ 'dir ni mi 'chad do/ /der ma zad/ paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rnam pa gnyis kyis mdzad par bcu gsum ma 'di bdag mdun tha mi dad pa 'jug pa gcig yin par rje'i dgongs pa yin par bshad nas bdag mdun gyi mchod pa gnyis chab gcig tu byin rlabs bya bar gsungs la/ rgyal dbang lnga pa dang*/ cang gya zhabs drung sogs ni/ mngon rtogs rkyang pa'i skabs su bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig mi gcig pa'i tha snyad mi 'thob par bshad pas/

'dir de 'thad pa ltar mthong ngo*/ /'on kyang khong rnams gnyis kyi dgongs pa yang dkyil 'khor sgrub pa lta bu'i skabs la dgongs par mngon te/ gzhan du na klan ka 'jug cing*/ khyad par du paṇa chen rin po ches ding sang nag 'gros su bkod pa'i par ma 'di gtor 'bul skabs sla chos su song bar bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni logs su shes par bya la/ skabs 'dir kha cig ni/ rdor sems bsgom pa'i tshe rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed yin pa'i dmigs pa nges par byed dgos par 'dod kyang*/ kho bo ni de mi rung ba min yang tha mal pa'i rnam pa can du gsal ba'i sby-ii bor rdor sems bsgoms na legs sam snyam/ gal te mngon rtogs snga ma song zhing*/ phyi ma la yang 'jug dgos pas lha'i nga rgyal las ma 'das so snyam na mi 'gal te/ lha'i nga rgyal yang blos gsar du bcos pa yin gyi/ 'gyur med min zhing*/ tshogs zhing gi thog mar yang*/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i zhes pa slar yang lhar bskyed par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thun dngos gzhir ji ltar bya ba la/ sgrub thabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i chings gnyis ka thob pas phyi ma la/ rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang shin tu rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po bzhi ste/ dang po ni/ stong nyid bsgoms pa nas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar nyi ma bskyed pa nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar dang*/ gsum pa ni mkha' gsang byin rlabs nas ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang bstim pa'i bar dang*/ bzhi pa ni de nas bzlas pa'i bar ro/ /'dir dang po'i dbang du byas na gsum/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la bslab tshul lo/ /dang po la bzhi/ 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer yan lag dang bcas pa la bslab tshul/

gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i rten gzhal yas khang bskyed nas bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed tshul/ skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed tshul/ sku gsum gyi go 'phang 'dod chags kyi chos kyis thob par bstan pa'i phyir rig ma'i 'dod yon la longs spyod tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ sngags spyod pa'i rten khyad par can 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan du skye ba len pa'i rgyur skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las mngon par 'du bya ba dang mthun par tshogs zhing mchod cing sdom pa 'dzin tshul/ de'i 'og tu 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byed pa dang chos mthun par ye shes kyi sa bsgom tshul/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bskyed de 'gal rkyen 'gog pa'i phyir srung 'khor bsgom tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis longs sprul gyi 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa rnams kyang gsal bar byas de na bzhugs pa'i zhes sogs kyi don dran pa'i sgo nas rdo rje 'jigs byed bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de'i tshe bla ma ni spyan drangs pa'i 'jigs byed de'i spyi bo'i rtsa zhal gyi steng*/ srin zhal gyi mdun du rigs bdag gi rnam par yod par bsam/ spyan 'dren pa'i gnas la/ sbyir rang bzhin gyi gnas zhes pa/ chos sku la rang bzhin gyi gnas su byas nas gzugs sku'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang*/ longs sku la rang bzhin gyi gnas su byas nas sprul sku'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang*/ gnas bye brag pa 'og min lta bu dang*/ rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas spyan 'dren pa sogs las 'dir ni longs sprul gyi zhing nas spyan 'dren pa yin no/ /bla ma yang rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes pa/

dngos kyi bla ma ste dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma rnams bla ma gcig tu 'dus par bsam pa'am/ so sor gang ba de yin la/ khyad par chos 'di'i nyams 'khrid kyi bla ma'o/ /'od zer rang gi snying khar bsdu zhing de ni snying khar rtsa 'khor yod mdor ro/ /de nas gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gis bla ma la phyag bya zhing*/ don ni/ bla ma gang gi bka' drin gyis mthar thug gi bde ba chen po'i gnas ni/ dus skad cig ste snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la thob par 'gyur bar mdzad pa'i bla ma rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang chos mtshungs pa'i 'bras dus kyi rdo rje can rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bltas pa'i zhabs kyi padmo la gus pas 'dud do zhes pa ste/ zhabs kyi padmo ni zhabs nyid la padmo'i ming gis btags pa yin gyi/ padma'i gdan ni min no/ / de'i don yang sku'i cha dma' shos la 'dud pa ni shin tu'ang gus pa'i don te/ yon tan khyad par can gzhan la 'dud pa lta ci smos pa'o/ /gzugs mchog sogs kyis 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ don ni/ 'bras dus kyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes gzugs sku'i rnam par shar bas na gzugs mchogaches cher khros pas na mchog tu drag po che/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rgyal bas na dpa' bo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas rnams sangs rgyas kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul yin pas na/ mchog gi spyod yul can/ gdul dka' ba phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje sogs 'dul ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ste/ de la drang nges gnyis yod pa'i 'bras dus kyi bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de nges don gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed dang de nyid gzugs sku'i rnam par rol pa 'jigs byed ni drang don gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed do/

/de nas rang gi snying kha nas tsartsi ka sogs mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi po re re yang mang du spros te/ mchod yon sogs kyis mchod par bsam/ de yang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣt+rīḥhas mchod yon 'bul zhing*/ sngags don ni 'phrog byed mche ba gtsigs pa la zhes gang la 'bul ba yul gyi khyad par/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis zhabs bsil/ tha mal gyi snang zhen bcad de bde stong gi rnam sprul zhes ngo bo'i khyad par/ oṃ wi kṛ nas ga gaḥyis dri/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal can sems can ma rungs pa bsgral ba'i snying khrag gi dri zhes rgyu'i khyad par/ oṃ ku ma ra rū pi ni dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ phaṭa kyis me tog yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs can zhes rnam pa'i khyad par/ oṃ hrīḥha he phaṭa kyis bdug spaus/ 'phrog byed dgyes pa'i ched du zhes dgos pa'i khyad par/ oṃ dīpta nas swāhās mar me/ don ni spyan gyi dbang po dgyes pa'i ched du zhes yul gyi gnas gang la 'bul ba'i khyad par bstan/ zhal zas dang rol mo gnyis rang ming gis smos pa ni tha ma'i gsal byed de/ khyad par de ltar shes pa'i sgo nas phul na phul du byung ba'i mchod par 'gyur bar bshad do/ /bshags pa ni/ sgo gsum dang 'brel pa'i sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi'o/ /tshul ji ltar na 'das pa'i dus su rang rgyud la skyes shing*/ da ltar gyi dus su rang rgyud la byung ba'i sdig pa rnams ni dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems dang bcas te bsal ba ste bshags pa'i sgo nas med par bya ba dang*/ der ma zad phyin chad mi byed par tshogs zhing khyed kyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i bsdom par brjod do/ /dus gsum gyi sdig pa bshags pa de bzhin du/ dus gsum gyi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ / tshul de ltar byas nas bsags pa'i dge ba rnams bdag gzhan kun bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bde blag 'gro ba'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /yang na bde 'gro bla med byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo ba'o/

/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song las sgrol zhing sangs rgyas la 'god pa dang*/ de'i ched du byang chub tu smon pa'i sems bskyed par bstan to/ /lus 'bul ba ni/ yon tan rgya mtsho ltar tshad med pa'i tshogs zhing khyed rnams la bdag gi lus 'bul zhing*/ lam bstan ni/ sangs rgyas dang de'i sras byang sems rnams kyi bgrod pa'i lam du gyur pa sbyin sogs kyi tshul de/ sku gsum dang ye shes lnga ldan gyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du rab tu dad pas rang rgyud la brten par bgyi'o zhes pa ni don bsdus pa ste/ 'di ni 'jugs sems su yang 'gyur ro/ /rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes sogs kyis ston te/ 'di yang don bsdu na gzhan rnams ni sla zhing*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i/ dge ba chos sdud kyi sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la nyin mtshan thun drug tu slob pa'am slob 'dod sbyong ba ni/ rnam snang gi sdom pa'i bslab bya la slob tshul dang*/ de bzhin du/ rgyal ba'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mtshon byed kyi chags tshad dang ldan pa'i rdo rje dang*/ stong nyid kyi rang sgra sgrogs par sems pa'i sgo nas chags tshad dang ldan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa ni dril bu'i dam tshig dang*/ rang lhar bsgoms nas las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang tshul bzhin snyoms par 'jug pas lha mchod pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go /rang la sngags kyi lam ston pa'i bla ma mchod pa ni slob dpon gyi dam tshig ste/ de sngar bzhin bsten pa ni/ mi bskyod pa'i dang*/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa rnams sngar bzhin bsten pa ni rin 'byung gi dang*/ phyi bya spyod dang*/

gsang ba rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor bla med nyan rang byang sems kyi theg pa gsum gyi lung rtogs kyi chos la sngar bzhin slob pa ni 'od dpag med kyi dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa la slob pa ni don grub kyi rigs kyi sdom pa'i bslab bya la slob tshul lo/ /ma bsgral ba sogs ni nyon sgrib las ma bsgral ba'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs bdag gis bsgral bar bya zhing*/ shes sgrib las ma grol ba'i nyan rang dgra bcom rnams bdag gis sgrol ba dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar nas dbugs ma phyin pa'i sems can rnams bdag gis dbugs dbyung ste/ sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la 'god par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /thun mong min pa'i sdom pa 'dir smos pa ni/ sdom pa sngar med gsar du skye ba dang*/ nyams pa sor chud pa'i ched du min kyang*/ sdom pa skyes zin gnas pa dang*/ gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /'dir sdom pa ma bzung na'ang cho ga la chad lhag tu ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom par bya zhing*/ dang po gsum ni spyi ltar la/ bzhi pa btang snyoms ni/ sems can thams cad rnyed pa dang*/ ma rnyed pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ mi bde ba dang*/ snyan pa dang*/ mi snyan pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ smad pa'i 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms la 'god pa dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i chos la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa de dag nye bar zhi ba'i btang snyoms la 'god par dam bca' ba'o/ /chos brgyad 'dren tshul la ming mi 'dra ba yod kyang don 'dra ba yin no/ /tshogs zhing ni/ mthar rang gnas su gshegs pa dang*/ de nyid du mi dmigs par bsgom pa dang*/ rang la bsdu ba dang*/ stong pa nyid du bsgom pa rnams su yod pa las 'dir phyi ma ltar ro/ /stong pa nyid du bsgom pa la mi dmigs pa'i tha snyad mdzad kyang*/ rnam bshad 'dod 'jo las mi snang bar byas pa tsam la mi dmigs pa zhes pa'i bsgom tshul yod par bshad cing*/

mkhas grub kyis kyang da ltar gsungs so/ /tshogs zhing nas 'di'i bar gyi mtshon don ni sa bcad kyi skabs su bshad cing 'chang bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byas pa dang chos mthun par ye shes kyi sa'i stong nyid bsgom tshul la gnyis/ sbyang gzhi bshad pa dang*/ de dang mthun par stong nyid bsgom tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling ba'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan gyis 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i tshul yod de/ de 'chi ba'i tshe thog mar sa chu la thim pa'i skabs su phyi rtags su lus bying pa'i nyams dang*/ nang rtags su smig rgyu lta bu'i snang ba 'char/ chu me la thim pa'i skabs phy-i rtags su mchu dang lce bskams shing so la dreg pa chags pa dang*/ nang rtags su du ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char/ me rlung la thim pa'i phyi rtags su lus kyi drod mtha' nas sdud pa dang*/ nang rtags su mkha' snang me khyer lta bu'i snang ba 'char/ rlung rnam shes pa thim par brtsams pa na phyi rtags su phyi'i dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'chad cing*/ nang rtags su mar me 'bar ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char/ kun rtog g.yo byad kyi rlung snang ba la thim pa'i snang ba rang dus su ston gnam g.ya' dag pa la zla 'od kyis khyab pa lta bu'i dkar lam pa'i snang ba 'char/ de mched pa la thim pa'i tshe de la nyi 'od kyis khyab pa lta bu dang*/ de nyer thob la thim pa'i tshe srod kyi mun pa 'thug po'i smag gis khyab pa lta bu'i snang ba 'char zhing*/ nyer thob de 'od gsal la thim pa'i tshe slong byed kyi rkyen gsum dang bral ba'i tho rangs kyi nam mkha' stong sang lta bu'i snang ba 'char ba'i sgo nas de mngon du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ sngags gnyis kyi don bshad pa'i sgo nas stong nyid bsgom tshul dngos dang*/ sbyang gzhi dang chos mthun sbyor ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sngags gnyis kyi dang po'i don ni/

oṃ gyi a u ma gsum gyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mtshon zhing*/ de gsum gcig tu gyur pa'i oṃ gyis rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed ba de mtshon/ mtshon don de dran pa'i sgo nas ngag tu brjod na bsod nams mang du sdud pas nor bu 'dzin pa'i sngags zhes brjod de/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par brjod/ /mchog dang nor dang dpal dang g.yang skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing*/ dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ nor bu 'dzin pa'i sngags su brjod/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ swā bhā wa ni rang bzhin gyis/ shuddhaḥni rnam par dag pa/ sarba dharma ni chos thams cad de/ yul gzung bas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i don dang*/ swā bhā wa shuddha ni sngar bzhin dang*/ a haṃ ni nga'o ste yul can nga sogs 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ste/ mdor na/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang nyid bden 'dzin gyis ji ltar bzung ba ltar med pa ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i don no/ /sngags gnyis pa'i don oṃ ni sngar bzhin dang*/ shūn+ya tā ni stong pa nyid/ dzñā na ni ye shes/

badzra ni mi phyed pa/ swā bhā wa ni rang bzhin*/ atma ko ni bdag nyid/ a haṃ ni nga'o ste/ yul stong pa nyid dang yul can bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbyer med pa'i lam gyi chos sku la nga rgyal bzhag nas bsgom pa'i don te/ ko3haṃ/ zhes sum 'khyog 'byung ba ni pa lū ta yin pas mig 'dzum gsum yun du bklag dgos pa'i don no/ /'dir chos sku la nga rgyal 'jog sa ni gzhi dus dang lam 'bras kyi chos sku gsum las phyi ma gnyis yin la/ 'bras dus kyi chos sku ni sangs rgyas yin kyang de la nga rgyal 'jog par bshad pa ni mos pa gtso bor byed pa ste/ de yang rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas 'bras dus kyi chos sku la nga rgyal gtso bor byed par bshad cing de ltar gsungs pa gzhan yang yong la/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs ni lam dus kyi chos sku la'ang bshad de mi 'gal lo/ /lam dus kyi skabs su yang stong nyid rtogs ma rtogs kyi dbye bas gnyis su 'gyur la/ rtogs pa la'ang bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes su song ma song gnyis yod do/ / spyir bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de la spyi don sbas don mthar thug gsum yod kyang 'dir dang po'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ lam dus kyi lhan skyes kyi dbang du byas pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes dngos ni bsgoms stobs kyis rlung dbu mar zhugs pa'i dbang gis gtum mo sbar bas byang sems bzhus nas skyes pa zhig dgos te/ rim lnga gsal sgron las/ bde stong sbyong bar gsungs pa'i bde ba ni lhan skyes kyi dga' ba yin la/ de thog mar skye ba ni ro rkyang gi rlung a wa dhū tīr btsud pa'i dbang gis gtum mo sbar nas byang sems bzhus pa las skye la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi dus kyi chos sku ni rang bzhin gyis med pa'i stong nyid de/ de yang yul gyi chos sku zhes tha snyad byed kyang chos sku dngos min la/

de rtogs pa'i slob ma'i ye shes rnams la skabs 'dir yul can gyi chos skur brjod pa'ang btags pa tsam mo/ /rang dang tshogs zhing gi lha dang de dag las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad rang rang gi gdags gzhi cha shas sogs la brten nas ming dang brda'am tha snyad kyis btags pa tsam gyis 'jog pa'i phyir na/ de rnams phan tshun ltos pa'i rten 'brel yin la/ ltos med rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rtag mtha'/ tha snyad du bya byed mi rung ba'i chad mtha'/ de gnyis su rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang de gnyis ka ma yin par yang rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral bar bshad pa ltar ram/ cung zad mi 'dra ba rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rtag mtha'/ tha snyad du med pa'i chad mtha'/ de gnyis su grub pa'i rtag mtha'/ de gnyis gang rung du yang med pa'i chad mtha' ste chos thams cad rtag chad kyi mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i bdag med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /bzhi gsungs pa ni/ blo la ldos te mtha' gzhan sel ba'i ched yin gyi/ mtha' bzhi ka'ang rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis su mi 'du ba min no/ /'dir rang bzhin gyis stong ces pas rtag mtha' sel zhing*/ brten nas btags pa'i phyir zhes pas chad mtha' sel te/ tha snyad du yod pas rang bzhin gyis med pa'i don no/ /de yang spy-i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis med cing tha snyad du yod pa'i mtha' gnyis dang bral yang*/ 'dir blos 'dzin tshul la ltos nas 'gog pa yin no/ /'o na/ stong nyid bsgom rgyu yod na de ltar yin mod/ stong nyid thos byung gi shes rab tsam gyis kyang ma nges pa dag gis ji ltar bya snyam na/ rab byung na stong nyid bsgoms byung gis rtogs pa'am/ med na bsam byung dang*/ de yang med na thos byung gi shes rab kyis rtogs dgos pa ni/ skabs 'dir yang*/ sngags kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya la dgos pa yin la/ gal te de dag med na/ stong nyid kyi go ba mdor bsdus pa yin na'ang rnam dag gi phyogs gtogs zhig nges par dgos so/

/gang zag 'di'am stong nyid rtogs pa zhig gis kyang*/ 'di ltar byas na legs par bshad de/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ snod bcud la phog pas/ de rnams 'od kyi rnam par zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas mi snang zhing mi dmigs par bsam/ stong nyid rtogs pa ma yin na'ang*/ re zhig rang gzhan kun rdzob pa'i chos rnams blo ngor mi snang bar bya ste/ spyir chos rnams med pa min kyang de ltar med pa bzhin byed pa ni/ dgos pa'i dbang yin pas mi 'gal bar ma zad/ rten dang brten pa bsgom pa'i grogs su 'gyur ba ni/ rje'i rnam bshad 'dod 'jo dang*/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa'ang yin no/ /gzhan yang*/ kho bo cag gis zhus pa'i 'khrid rgyun las/ rang yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams dang hūṃ gi nā da las 'od zer 'phros/ tshogs zhing dang snod bcud la phog pas de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ rang gi stod smad sogs nas zhu ste thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim pas du ba lta bu dang*/ hūṃ gi zhabs kyu'i ū ni ha la thim pas me 'khyer dang*/ ha mgo bo la thim pas mar me dang*/ de zla tshes la thim pas snang ba dkar lam pa dang*/ de thig le la thim pas mched pa dmar lam pa dang*/ de nā da la thim pas nyer thob nag lam pa dang*/ nā da de 'od gsal du thim pas tho rangs nam mkha'i rang mdog lta bu'i snang ba shar byung snyam du mos dgos par bshad pas/ 'di ltar byed pa ni 'chi rim dang chos mthun sbyor ba dang*/ de'i lam khyer la phan che ba zhig go /gnyis pa ni/ sngags gnyis kyi don dran pa'i sgo nas stong nyid sgom tshul 'di la 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor dang lam khyer zhes bya ste/ sbyang gzhi la 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan zhigarang gi gzugs sogs phung po lnga/ sa sogs khams lnga/ mig sogs dbang po lnga/ gzugs sgra sogs yul lnga/

gzhi dus kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes sogs ye shes lnga ste rags pa nyer lnga rim gyis thim nas 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byed pa dang chos mthun zhing*/ sgrub pa po rang nyid ky-ii 'chi ba sbyong bar byed/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su bsgoms stobs kyis rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i dpe dpe don gyi 'od gsal dang rnam pa mthun zhing*/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa skye ba'i dge rtsa smin byed du 'gyur/ 'bras bu'i skabs su yul dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings dang*/ yul can sgrib bral gyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis chu la chu bzhag bzhin du ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i thugs ye shes chos sku dang rnam pa mthun zhing*/ de lam du byas pa'i tshul gyis mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs 'dir stong nyid bsgom pa la ye shes kyi sa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi la snod kyi 'jig rten snga ma zhig stong nas nam mkha' stong sang du gnas pa de nyid kyis snod kyi 'jig rten phyi ma zhig gi rten byed pa de bzhin du/ /'dir bsgoms pa'i stong nyid kyis 'byung bzhi dang rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i gzhi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ 'dir stong nyid bsgoms pa la dgos pa yod de/ /gtso bo ni 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer dang*/ gzhan gong du bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas/ 'dir ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa dang*/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi gzung rnam de nyid rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam rol du 'char ba'i zab gsal gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor khyad par can 'grub pa dang*/ srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas 'gal rkyen 'gog pa'i ched du srung 'khor bsgom pa la gnyis/

'byung bzhi bskyed de thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bsgom tshul dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgom tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ chos sku 'ba' zhig la mi gnas par gzugs skur ldang nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas nus na blo'i cha phye ste/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ sngon mo zhig thol gyis 'byung ba las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can gzhu gdungs pa lta bu'i mchog ma gnyis su rgyal mtshan dar lce gsum pas mtshan pa/ bcad kha phar la bstan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ dmar po las me dkyil zur gsum pa zur gcig mdun du bstan pa/ kha la me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bam dkar po las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po dbus su bum pa chus gang bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam ser po las sa dkyil gru bzhi pa zur bzhir rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de dag gi yi ge rnams nyal 'greng gang bde bya'o/ /'dir 'byung ba rim brtsegs bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten snga ma zhig stong nas phyi ma 'chags pa na/ dang por rlung dkyil nas 'chags pa sogs dang chos mthun sbyor ba'i ched do/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs la me dkyil dngos gnas pa yod cing*/ mngon pa nas me dkyil dngos gnas pa yod par ma bshad kyang skyon med do/ /'byung ba gzhan gsum la me rdul yod pas chos mthun du sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sa dkyil gyi dbus steng du hūṃ yig sngon po zhig byung ba zhu ste/ sna tshogs rdo rje mngon rtogs ltar gyi rwa can gyi lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa dbyibs zlum por rung*/ de las 'od zer rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi ste/ sa dkyil dang steng ngos mnyam pa byas kyang mi 'gal bar sems/ logs su 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po sogs gur gyi smad lta bu/ steng du gdugs btegs pa ltar 'phros pas tsha tsha'i stod sog gur gyi stod kyi rnam pa can lta bu'i rdo rje gur/

yang 'phros pas gur gyi 'og dang rwa ba'i steng gi mtshams su rdo rje'i bla bre bres pa/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur rnams kyang rdo rje bsnol ma'am/ chu rgyug 'bum brtsegs gang rung du rdo rje che ba rnams kyi khong seng du chung ba rnams kyis rdul phra rab kyi tshul du gtams pa bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol du/ de dag las 'phros pa'i ye shes kyi me dbang ldan nas brtsams te dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i kha dog sna lnga pa 'jig dus kyi me ltar phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'phro ba/ nag phyogs pa rnams kyis 'da' nus pa ltar zhog bltar mi bzod pa/ dkar phyogs pa rnams kyis yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can du mthong bar bsam par bshad do/ /srung 'khor 'di bsgom pa ni/ sgrub thabs bsgom pa la bgegs kyi bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched yin la/ der ma zad thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor yang de'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i srunga'akhor ni/ rwa ba'i dbus su bhruṃ ser po zhig byung ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bka'i 'khor lo ser po ye shes bcu'i bdag nyid las byung ba'i rtsibs bcu pa dbyibs mdung lcags kyi sbubs yangs pa gnyis kha sprad pa lta bu'i steng 'og gi rtsibs gnyis mdung rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa la/ lte ba'i phrad mtshams kyi phyogs bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir yu ba thug pa'i rtsibs ral gri so gnyis ma lta bu brgyad/ lte ba'i dbus dang steng 'og gi sbubs stong gi bar snang dang*/ phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs rnams kyi rtse mo la cung zad ma reg pa'i gnas rnams su sna tshogs padma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma'i gdan gsum gsum brtsegs pa'i dbus kyi gdan la/ rang nyid gnod mdzes rgyal po sku mdog dang rtsa zhal mthing ka zhal gsum ka'i dbu thod kyi rdza ma dang mgrin pa gcig pa la/ snyan phan chad 'bur po gsum du dod pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yas g.yon gyi sog pa'i dkar yol kha gnyis nas dpung mgo gsum gsum yas man du gyes pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyi rang 'dra'i yum la 'byung cing*/

g.yas 'og ma gnyis rin po che dang lcags kyu/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i nyams yongs su rdzogs shing*/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams dang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad khro bo bcu'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi zhal du zhugs thugs kar chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar song ste rang mdog can gyi thig le bcu dang*/ de las de lta bu'i hūṃ ring po bcur gyur pa zhu ba las/ khro bo bcur gyur hūṃ ring po zhes pa la kha cig ā ring po dang ldan pa'i hūṃ la 'dod cing*/ la la hūṃ yig nā da can la 'dod de/ dang po ltar na hūṃ thung dkar ba'i ched yin la/ phyi ma ltar na dpyad dgos so/ /de nas 'khor gshin rje gshed sogs ni sgrub thabs bzhin gsal btab ste/ re re nas hūṃ zhes brjod de bskul ba yum gyi padma ste mngal gyi sgo nas phyir spros/ shar sogs phyogs mtshams brgyad dang*/ steng 'og gi gdan la g.yon brkyang gis 'khod par bsams shing*/ gzhan brgyad kha nang lta dang*/ gtsug tor 'khor sgyur ni/ gtso bo'i steng gi mdun ngos su cung zad yol ba'i gdan la zhal nub dang*/ rdo rje sa 'og ni gtso bo'i 'og gi rgyab ngos su cung zad yol nas zhal shar du gzigs pa'o/ /spro ba'i tshe slar yang rang gi thugs kar 'dren par bshad pa ni/ rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin yang*/ 'don cha'i tshig zin dang mi mthun par mngon no/ khro bo thams cad kyang mche ba gtsigs shing*/ zhab so so yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa sogs sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba'i rdo rje che chung sna tshogs dang*/ bcu ka la'ang khro chung zhun ma'i khu ba phyir 'thor ba lta bu dang*/ ye shes kyi me ra ba'i phyi rol du'ang 'phro bas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod par bsam/

de yang khro bo rnams kyis rang phyogs bzung nas mi 'khor la/ 'khor lo ni sa gzhi rwa gur khro bo rnams la ma reg par g.yas bskor du mgyogs par 'khor bar bsam zhing 'di la khro bo'i sngags bzla ba dang*/ 'khor lo 'khor ba'i gnad/ bsgrub bya snga ba'i gnad/ khro bo zhal gzigs pa'i gnad/ 'phrin las mdzad pa'i gdan rnams 'dod na/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas kyi rten gzhal yas khang bskyed de bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa la gnyis/ rten gzhal yas khang bshad pa dang*/ lam khyer rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ gzhal yas khang gi gdan dang*/ gzhal yas khang dngos bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid gnod mdzes su gnas pa de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ de yang zhu ba las chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ 'og tu phra zhing stong yangs pa/ dbyibs cung zad mi 'dra ba yod kyang dmar gtor mgo mjug zlog pa lta bu/ zur gcig mdun du bstan pa ste/ chos 'byung phyi dkar bas bde ba dang*/ nang dmar pas stong pa mtshon pa'am ldog ste mtshon pa gang byas kyang mi 'gal snyam/ chos 'byung nyid kyis bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes mtshon/ zur gsum gyis rnam thar sgo gsum dang*/ shes rab ma'i bha ga'i dbyibs kyis lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang*/ 'og phra zhing stod yangs pas ni/ mos spyod kyi sa'i yon tan phra zhing sa gong ma rnams yon tan je rgyas su yod pa mtshon no/ /chos 'byung gi 'og zur nas paṃ yig ljang khu zhig byung ba yongs su gyur pa las/ yu ba 'og zur nas 'thon pa'i sna tshogs padma lte ba rgya che zhing 'dab ma chung ba ste 'dab ma dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i kha dog sna tshogs sbel ba/ 'dab ma'i grangs re bzhi'am/ so gnyis sam/ bcu drug yod pa gang rung*/

'dab ma'i shar gyi phyi mtha' nas nub kyi phyi mtha'i bar sgo tshad nyer gcig ste cha phran gya bzhi yod pa dang*/ lho mtha' nas byang mtha'i bar yang de ltar yod pa'i lte ba ljang ge sar ser po/ lte ba'i phyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar gyi rgya la sgo tshad nyi shu ste cha phran brgyad cu'o/ /de'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po nyal 'greng gang rung la sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya ni padma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ rā nyi shu ba dang bcu gnyis pa gang rung*/ rwa rnams phyogs mdog gam rwa khra gang ba de/ lte ba sngon po/ dbyibs bre leb kha sbubs pa lta bu gru bzhi pa/ dpangs ni/ cha phran bzhi dang lnga dang cha chen bzhi dang lngar yang bshad snang ba las rwa nyi shu pa la phyi ma gang rung*/ ra bcu gnyis pa la ni dpangs cha chen gcig tu bshad/ de gnyis ka la'ang lte ba'i rgyar sgo tshad bcu gnyis/ rwa dbus ma rnams kyi rtsa ba la cha phran gsum dbus la cha phran bzhi/ rtse mo la cha phran gcig

/phyogs rwa rnams kyi rtsa ba la gnyis/ dbus la gsum/ rtser cha phran sum gnyis/ rwa thams cad kyi srid la cha phran bcu drug /phyogs rwa rnams dbus rwa'i tshangs thig nas phyogs phyogs su cha phran brgyad re song ba'i mtshams nas rwa'i phyi dang*/ drug re song ba na nang mtha' 'thon zhing*/ dbus rwa'i cha phran gnyis phyir song ba'i mtshams su zug pa/ cha phran gnyis phyogs su ma sleb pa ni gug pa'i cha la song ba dang*/ rwa de rnams chu srin gyi kha nas 'thon pa'o/ /dgos pa ni gzhal yas khang gi rten gyi don du yin la/ mtshon don ni sna tshogs padmas 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs gnad du bsnun pa'i rtsa 'khor mtshon/ sna tshogs rdo rjes ye shes lnga dang*/ rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams ye shes lnga'i rnam rol du 'char dgos pa de mtshon no/ /gnyis pa gzhal yas khang dngos bskyed pa ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i dbus su bhruṃ dkar po las 'khor lo dkar po rdo rje'i yu ba can gyi lte bar bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po mngon rtogs bzhin dang*/ de zhu ba las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur par bsam/ gzhal yas khang gi rgya dpangs ni/ de'i shar gyi nang mtha' nas nub kyi nang mtha'i bar gyi rgya tshad ni cha phran bzhi la sgo tshad du byas pa'i sgo tshad brgyad/ rtsig pa lnga pa sdoms pa'i zheng cha phran gcig dpangs cha phran bcu gsum/ de'i steng du pha gu dmar po dpangs cha phran gcig zheng cha phran phyed gnyis yod pa'i phyed rtsig pa las phyir 'phags pa'i phyi ngos su rin po che zur gsum dang*/ zlum po dang*/ gru bzhi la sogs pa kha dog sna tshogs pa spel ba 'bur 'dod byas pas spras pa/ de'i steng gi phyogs bzhir par thag 'tsham par/ rdo smug po rdo rje'i snying po can gyi ka chung re re de'i steng du mu tig dmar po'i bre re re/

de'i steng du spug gi gzhu thung re/ de'i mchog ma gnyis su shel gyi ka chung re/ de'i steng du baiḍūrya sngon po'i bre re/ de'i steng du dngul gyi gzhu ring ste/ la lar gzhu thung de nyid skor ru khar btang ba'i phyogs bzhir shel gyi ka chung re byed par yang bshad/ de dag gi steng du gser gyi ska rags zheng cha phran gcig pa leb mor yod pa phyogs thams cad du 'khar mar btang ba/ tshul de lta bur brtsegs pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi ka bsdoms pa'i dpangs cha phran gcig ka ba bre phul dang bcas pa gong 'og bzhi bsdoms pa'i dpangs la cha phran gcig ste thams cad bsdoms pa la cha phran gnyis so/ khyad par du gzhal yas khang gi zur du rdo'i ka ba sogs yod pa bya dgos shing*/ de yang gzhung gong 'og ni zur dang mthun par bya'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i rtsa thig dang tshangs thig 'phrad mtshams nas g.yas g.yon du cha phran gnyis song ba na sgo tshad gcig ni sgo 'khyud/ de nas kyang cha phran gnyis re g.yas g.yon du song ba sgo 'gram/ de nas cha phran gnyis re phyir song ba sgo logs kyi nang ngos/ de'i rtsig gdong gi bar na sgo med pa ma gtogs/ ya them ma them 'gram rnams sgo ji lta ba bzhin btsugs pa'i ya them gyi rtsig pa ni dpangs ji ltar rigs par sgo logs kyi rtsig pa dang mnyam par btang ba/ de'i steng du pha gu ka ba bre phu la sogs kyang sngar bzhin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i rtsa thig dang tshangs thig 'phrad mtshams nas nang du cha phran re song ba na/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'am/ rtse gsum pa'i phreng bas zlum por bskor ba la dpangs cha phran gcig pa/ de dang 'brel bar rdo rje'i mig mangs ris su rgyugs pa'i mtshams su rdo rje'i 'phreng bar brtan pa'i ka ba zheng cha phran gcig dpangs cha phran bcu gsum yod pa phyogs bzhir gnyis gnyis te brgyad btsugs/ de'i bre gzhu thung gzhu ring dang bcas pa la cha phran gnyis te ka ba'i rtsa ba nas de'i bar cha phran bco lnga/

de'i steng du gdung 'khor dpangs cha phran gcig pa/ gdung 'khor dang shar nub lho byang gi ka ba 'phrad mtshams su gdung dang steg mnyam par byas te sne mo bkal pa'i gdung ring dpangs cha phran gcig pa thal mar btang ba/ 'on kyang gdung 'di gdung 'khor 'phrad mtshams su bkal ba dang gdung gi steng du rang sor bzhag pa gnyis kyi khyad par las nang gi dpangs cha phran bcu drug dang bcu bdun du'ang 'gyur bas brtag gdung 'og gi ka ba ni/ tshangs thig dang rdo rje'i phreng ba 'phrad mtshams nas g.yas g.yon du cha phran lnga lnga song ba'i mtshams nas btsugs pa ste/ 'di'ang rdor 'phreng gi bar dang steng du bzhag pa la khyad par yod pas zhib cha gyis/ de ltar byas pas steng 'og gnyis ka la re mig dgu pa 'ong*/ dbus kyi re mig gru bzhi pa ma gtogs re mig gzhan rnams kyi 'og ngos su gnam rgyan/ shar lho nub byang gi ka gdung rnams rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang ba la/ rim par 'khor lo nor bu padma ral gris mtshan pa'o/ /phyi 'khyams gru bzhi pa'i lcam 'gel ba'i tshul ni/ zur lcam khra bo lcam sne phyi ma la chu srin ma ka ra'i mgo yod pa gser gyi ska rags rnams la bkal ba'i sne mo gser gyi ska rags las cha phran phyed gnyis phyir thal ba/ nang ma gdung 'khor zlum po la bkal ba/ de bzhin du phyogs bzhi'i sgo 'khyud kyi nang ngos nas gdung phreng la btang ba/ sgo 'khyud phan tshun gyi gser gyi ske rags gnyis pa la sne mo bkal ba'i zheng cha phran gcig sring cha phran lnga pa la lcam sne phyi ma dang*/ sgo 'khyud g.yas g.yon gyi gser gyi ske rags rnams kyi steng du lcam sne phyi ma cha phran re re phyir thal ba'i sne mor chu srin ma ka ra'i mgo yod pa dang*/ lcam sne nang ma rnams rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyi steng du 'khor bar bkal/ yang gdung zlum gyi steng du phyi ma dang*/ nang ma dbus kyi rgya thong gru bzhi pa'i gdung la cha phran re nang du thal ba'i lcam 'gel/

'dir phyi nang gi lcam rnams gcig tu byed pa'i srol yang snang ste mi 'gal/ sgo logs g.yas g.yon gyi gser gyi ska rags kyi steng du cha phran re re'i sar chu srin gyi mgo yod pa'i lcam btsugs/ lcam grangs ni phyogs bzhir nyer brgyad re bya bar bshad/ rgya thong gru bzhi pa'i lcam sne nang ma rnams kyi steng du gud du btags pa'i bre phul lcam sne snga ma rnams las cha phran phyed re nang du thal ba'i sne mo dang*/ 'og gi lcam sne gnyis su gsal byed kyi nor bu dga' bas 'khyil pas mdzes par bya/ 'ga' zhig las steng du btags pa de mi snang ngo*/ /de dag la gral ma btang ste thog 'geb/ phyi khyams kyi lcam sne phyi ma la chu srin gyi mgo bo yod pa byas te de rnams kyi steng du gdung thung re btang ba'i sne ni chu srin gyi mgo bo yod pa las tha phran phyed kyis ring ba'o/ /de'i steng du bya 'dab bkal ba'i sne mo la/ rin po che'i shar bu dkar po sbyi blugs mchu med mgo mjug zlog pa lta bu'am rus rgyan rnying ba'i za ra tshags lta bu/ bya 'dab zheng cha phran gnyis/ kha cig ltar bya 'dab kyi rtsa bar ram/ shar bu'i thad kyi bya 'dab kyi steng du mda' yab dkar po padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ dpangs zheng gnyis kar cha phran re re yod pa pu shu ltar bslangs pa/ chu srin gcig gi kha nas gcig gi khar rin po che'i phreng ba'i dra ba nyis bshibs su 'phyang ba/ chu srin rnams kyi kha'i dbus nas rin po che'i dra phyed sum bshibs su phyang ba'i sne mor nor bu sbom po gser gyi pa ṭas bsdams pa/ dril chung dang*/ rnga yab rin po che'i yu ba can btags pa sbel mar brgyan pa/ dra ba phyi ma'i khug pa'i dbus su nor bu pa ṭas bsdams pa che ba re re dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du chung ba re/ chu srin rnams kyi kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du nor bu pa ṭas bsdams pa che ba re dang*/ de'i 'og tu chung ba re/

dra ba nang ma'i steng gi nang ngos su kha cig tu padma la zla ba phyed pa la lar nyi ma la rdo rje phyed pa/ 'gal zhig tu padma la rin po che dmar po cha dgu pa dang*/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du bsgreng ba rnams ni sbel mar gnas pa/ de dag gi g.yas g.yon du me long la btags pa'i gos kha dog sna tshogs pa byi'u khrug khar bsgrigs pa'i 'phan chung re re/ de'i g.yas g.yon du de las thung tsam gyi me tog sna tshogs pa'i 'phreng ba re re ste/ de rnams kyi rtse mo zla phyed rdo rje sogs la ma reg pa'o/ /steng gi zur bzhir spre'u kha nang blta mjug ma mda' yab kyi steng du bkal ba lag tu gdugs 'dzin pa re re'am/ yang na gser gyi bum pa cha phran gcig pa bzhi nas yu ba cha phran gnyis 'thon pa'i g.yogs cha phran gnyis pa'i gdugs dkar po dar lce'i sham bu dang bcas pa/ zla phyed rdo rje tog gis mtshan pa/ gdugs tog dang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran gsum/ g.yogs la cha phran phyed gsum/ g.yogs kyi steng du rin po che'i dra ba dra phyed nyil lera'aphyang ba'o/ /yongs grags kyi gdugs la sham bu 'dug mod/ 'dir gdugs rang la dar gyi sham bu yod med dpyad dgos par snang ngo*/ /phyogs bzhir mda' yab kyi steng du/ gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad byed pa'i don ni/ phyogs re rer rgyal mtshan gnyis dang ba dan gnyis re ste/ so sor bgrang na bcu drug 'byung ba'i don yin gyi/ phyogs re re na rgyal mtshan brgyad dang ba dan brgyad yod pa min no/ /rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyi khyad par ni/ khebs kyi nang du dar lce gsum pa sum khug 'khyog cing 'gying ba la ni srog chags gsum gyi mtshan ma sogs yod pa ni rgyal mtshan dang*/ de med pa ni ba dan no/ /mtshan ma de ldan gyi dar lce'i rtser rnga yab dang dril bu g.yer kha sil sil gyi sgra ldan no/ /gzhan yang*/

ngang pa klu za ba dang*/ rma bya dang*/ mi'am ci pho mo rnams kyi mtshan ma yod pa ni rgyal mtshan du'ang bshad/ srog chags gsum ni/ seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa nya spu rgyas pa/ chu srin ma ka ra gsum mo/ /seng ge rkang pa brgyad ces pa ni/ seng ge dang mkha' ldeng 'dus pa las byung ba'i seng ge ste/ seng ge'i sbar mo bzhi dang*/ khyung gshogs gnyis sder mo gnyis dang brgyad yin la/ seng ge'i mgo bo la khyung gi mchu can no/ /nya dang sram las nya sbu can de mgo lus nya las sram gyi mche ba dang mjug ma can no/ /dung dang chu srin las chu srin ma ka ra ste/ lus ni dung dang chu srin gyi mgo can no zhes bshad/ g.yogs sogs ni sngar bzhin no/ /dbus kyi re mig steng du gser gyi rgya phig 'bubs tshul ni/ rgya mthong gru bzhi pa'i kha gdang gi mtshams bzhi nas rtsa ba zug pa'i ka ba mgo mjug bsegs kha can zheng cha phran gcig dang dpangs cha chen gsum pa gnyis gnyis mgo shar nub tu dud pa'i bar du sgrogs thung btang ste/ de'i steng du rgya phib kyi gdung zheng cha chen gcig dang srid sgo tshad drug gam lnga yong ba'i gdung leb btang*/ phyi khyams gru bzhi ba'i phyogs mtshams kyi kha gdangs la ka ba bre phul sogs sngar bzhin byas te/ cha phran re re'i sar btsugs pa'i steng du gdung phyogs thams cad du thal rgyugs su btang ba/ ka ba nas gdung gi bar bsdoms pa'i dpangs la sgo tshad gcig yod pa/ lcam sne nang ma rgya phib kyi gdung dang sgrogs thung gnyis la bkal cing*/ phyi ma kha gdangs kyi gdung la bkal ba'i cha phran phyed re phyir thal ba/ phyogs bzhi'i lcam sne phyi ma rnams kyi steng ngos su pad 'dab phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi chu skyor gyen du langs pa byas te/ rgya phib kyi thog 'geb/ rgya phib kyi lho byang gi gdung sne gnyis su mgrin pa dang bcas pa'i khyung mgo'i rwa bar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa/

khyung gi kha nas skud pa dmar po las brgyus pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba'i dra ba dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba'i sne mo sgrogs thung la sleb pa/ lcam sne phyi ma rnams la'ang chu srin gyi mgo yod pa'i kha nas dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba/ de lta bu'i rgya phib rta rgyab can gyi dbus su/ gsung rgyun 'ga' zhig las/ gser gyi khang bu dpangs zheng gnyis kar cha phran gnyis re yod pa'i nang du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rnams bzhugs zhes gsungs/ la lar de med par/ padma rā ga'i pad spungs cha phran gnyis pa bya bar bshad/ de'i steng du rin po ched cha dgu pa'-i tog dpangs cha phran gcig pa'i steng du rin po che'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa srid cha phran gcig pa gyen du bsgreng ba bya ba dang*/ la lar tog gdugs ltar sum brtsegs can du bshad/ gang ltar yang gzhal yas khang g-i 'og gi mthil nas tog gi rtse mo'i bar sgo tshad brgyad yod pa byas tshe/ rgya mnyam dpangs mnyam dang 'og gi mthil nas bar gyi gdung gi bar sgo tshad bzhi yod pas rgya byed dpangs mnyam mo/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo 'khyud kyi steng gi lcam ni/ sngar bshad pa'i phyi khyams gru bzhi pa'i lcam sne phyi ma 'gel ba'i gdung dang*/ sgo 'khyud kyi phyi ngos su phrad la btang ba'i gdung gnyis kyi bar du lcam bzhi phrad la btang*/ sgo 'khyud phyi ngos kyi gdung dang*/ sgo logs kyi steng gi gser gyi ska rags thog tu bkal ba'i lcam sne phyi ma gser gyi ska rags las cha phran phyed phyir thal ba/ sgo 'khyud phan tshun du thal ba'i lcam sner chu srin gyi mgo bya/ sgo logs g.yas g.yon gyi steng du pad chod kyi phur bu btsugs te chu srin gyi kha byas nas thog bkab/ de lta bu'i lcam rnams kyi dpangs la cha phran phyed dang*/ gral ma thog dang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran phyed yin pas bsdoms na cha phran gcig po/ /sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon du sgo'i ru gzhi zhing cha phran phyed pa/

phan tshun gyi 'gram gnyis dang steng ngos su pad chod yod pa btsugs la sgo glegs zheng cha phran phyed gnyis yod pa 'byed bsdom nang nas byed cing*/ phye tshe phyir 'gro ba phyogs mdog sgo'i ya them dang gdung gi bar du shar du 'khor lo dkar po nyis brtsegs nyis bshibs/ de bzhin du lhor rin po che/ nub tu padma/ byang du ral gri rnams kyang ngo*/ /gzhal yas khang gi 'og gi zur thig gis bcad pa'i steng 'og rnams shar dkar ba sogs dang*/ 'dir rtsig pa'i nang thams cad ni mdog sngon po'o/ /sgo bzhi yang phyogs mdogartsig pa'i mtha' skor du 'dod snam dmar po dpangs cha phran gcig /zheng cha phran gnyis yod pa'i steng du lha mo phyag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa gar stabs la sogs pa'i bzhugs stangs dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs pa/ gzhal yas khang la phyogs de mchod pa byed bzhin pa'o/ /sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi phyi mtshams dang gzhal yas khang gi phyi nang gi zur rnams su zla ba phyed pa la rin po che dmar po dang rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa re re ste grangs ni nyer bzhi 'byung yang*/ mkhas pa kha cig so gnyis su bzhed de brtag rta babs ni/ sgo so so'i mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba zad mtshams su bang rim thog ma'i dpangs de dang mnyam zhing*/ bang rim bzhi pa re re'i dpangs su sgo tshad re dang zhing cha phran gsum srid cha phran bcu drug tu mnyam pa/ dbus rwa'i g.yas g.yon du bang rim re re la'ang them skas rim pa bzhi bzhi'am lnga yod pa gang rung*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa dang them skas gcig gis gcig bsgribs pa med cing gsal ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje rwa gsum ma la dpangs ni sgo tshad gcig nges par dgos shing*/ de las ma mthos kyang mi 'gal/ them pa gong ma'i g.yas g.yon du rwa rtsa'i thad la stegs bu gru bzhi pa ji ltar 'tshams pa'i steng du phyogs re rer g.yas g.yon gyis phye ba'i bzhi bzhi ste/

gser gyi bum pa nas thon pa'i stegs ka ba bum pa dang bcas pa'i dpangs cha phran lnga re/ rta babs dang sgo logs ngos kyi bar na cha chung gcig ste ka ba rnams phyogs mdog yin la/ ka ba nang ma dang sgo logs bar yang cha chung gcig go /'ga' zhig g.yas g.yon re rer ka ba bzhi bzhi dang*/ de dag gi steng du gdung bzhi 'gel ba sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba'i lugs kyang yod/ gang ltar yang ka ba'i steng du gdung btang nas de'i steng du snam bu dang po gser snam ser po/ srid cha phran phyed gsum re yod pa/ de'i steng du snam bu gnyis pa shar bu dkar po gzhi sngon po la dbyibs snga ma bzhin du yod pa snam bu gsum pa rin po che ni/ gzhi dmar po la zur gsum dang gru bzhi sogs kyis mdzes pa ste/ de gnyis kyi dpangs cha phran re re dang srid cha phran gsum gsum/ snam bu bzhi pa rta rmig ni gzhi ljang khu la rta rmig gi ri mos mtshan pa/ srid cha phran lnga snam bu lnga pa mun snam ni snam bu gong 'og gi bar stong ste/ ka ba zheng cha phran gcig dpangs cha phran phyed gnyis re phyogs mdog can phyi nang du bsgrigs pa/ snam bu drug pa wa raṇḍa ni kha dog sna tshogs pa/ srid cha phran lnga/ snam bu bdun pa yang mun snam ste sngar bzhin la/ ka ba de'i phyi mtha' dang mun snam 'og ma'i ka ba'i nang mtha' gnyis thang drang por yod pa/ brgyad pa shar bu/ dgu ba rin po che/ bcu pa rmig pa/ bcu gcig pa mda' yab rnams g.yas g.yon dang rgyab 'brel bar gnas pa'i kha dog dang dbyibs sngar bzhin dang*/ 'og ma gsum gyi srid cha phran bcu bzhi dang*/ mda' yab kyi snam bu'i srid cha phran bcu ste/ mda' yab dang de'i snam bu ni gcig min no/ /mun snam gnyis ma gtogs pa'i snam bu rnams dpangs cha phran re re dang zheng snam bu thams cad la cha phran gsum gsum ste/ cha phran bzhi bzhir yang rung bar bshad/ snam bu bzhi pa'i srid la cha phran gsum byed pa'i lugs snang yang*/

rtsa tshig las sngar bshad pa dang mi mthun no/ kha cig mda' yab kyi snam bu'i steng du snam bu dkar po mda' yab dang kha mnyam par bya bar bshad cing la lar de mi 'byung ngo*/ /de'i dbus su pad zla'am zla rkyang gi steng du ni/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ dpangs zheng gnyis kar cha phran gnyis sam re re gyen du bslangs pa de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo nyal stabs su gnas shing*/ mig 'khor lo'i rtse mor lta ba'i dpangs la cha phran phyed gnyis sam gcigade gnyis kyi rgyab tu mda' yab phyi nang gnyis btsugs pa'i nang mar spre'u gdugs 'dzin pa dang*/ phyi ma la gser bum du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan spel mar byas pa/ wa raṇḍa'i snam bu'i steng gi mchog ma gnyis su'ang de lta bu dang rta mig 'og ma la'ang de ltar byed par bshad cing mun snam gnyis kyi steng gi snam bu 'degs byed kyi seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ rma bya dang mi'am ci'i gzugs brnyan bya bar sngags rim nas bshad do/ /de yang wa raṇḍa'i snam bu ni sdod mi nyan pa ltar snang ba de la 'degs byed 'di byas na legs sam snyam/ glang rgyab kyi steng gi nang ngos su bla re rnam par bkra ba srid cha phran drug pa dang dra ba dra phyed mdzes par byas pa/ gser snam la btags pa'i gos kha dog sna tshogs spel mar 'phyang ba sogs so/ /rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du rdo rje'i lte ba lhag pa la gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i 'phreng ba dang gos 'phyang ba'i yal ga drug pa can gyi dbus ma la khyim bdag dmar po mdzod ldan kha nang du phyogs pa/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te mtha' skor du yal ga drug la 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ nor bu ser po rtsibs drug pa'am sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ bud med sngon po/ rta mchog ljang khu/ glang chen dkar po/ dmag dpon nag po ral gri can rnams so/

/de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar rang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog can gyi grub chen re/ de dag gi nam mkha'i sprin gseb nas lha'i bu kha dog sna tshogs pas me tog bzung ste char 'bebs pa'o//rdor ra me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod rnams kyis bskor ba'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ shar du gtum dragalhor keng rus can/ nub tu rdo rje 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshing khrigs pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa/ shar lhor bkra shis mchog gam tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa drag po/ nub byang du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams so/ /de na gnas pa'i shing brgyad ni/ shar du nā ga gser/ lhor kaṅke la/ nub tu tsunta/ byang du a shwattha/ byang shar du ne grodta/ shar lhor ka rañdza/ lho nub tu pa ṭa brka/ nub byang du barthi rnams so/ /shing de dag gi rtsa bar rim bzhin shar du brgya byin dkar po/ /lhor gshin rje sngon po/ nub tu chu lha dkar po/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po/ byang shar du dbang phyug dkar po/ shar lhor me lha dmar po/ lho nub du srin po sngon po/ /nub byang du rlung lha du ba'i mdog can rnams rang rang gi bzhon pa la zhon te zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas g.yas 'og ma rnams kyis rim pa bzhin rdo rje dbyug pa sprul nor bu skyugs pa'i ne'u le rtse gsum bgrang 'phreng ral gri ba dan bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon thams cad thod khrag thugs kar bzung nas rang gi yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /shing de dag gi rtse mor gnas pa'i phyogs skyong rnams kyi bzhon pa'i gdong brnyan gyi zhing skyong brgyad ni/ shar du glang po'i gdong can dkar po/ lhor ma he'i gdong can sngon po/ nub tu sprul gdong can dkar po/ byang du mi gdong can ser po/ byang shar du glang gdong can dkar po/ shar lhor ra skyes gdong can dmar po/ lho nub tu ro langs gdong can sngon po/

nub byang du sha ba'i gdong can dud kha ste/ de thams cad kyang drag cing gtum la rdzu 'phrul che ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa shing gseb nas lus phyed phyir 'thon pa/ g.yas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thams cad gtor ma bzung nas brel ba'i tshul du gnas pa'o/ /shing de dag gi mdun ngos su chu brgyad dang*/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad ni/ shar gyi chur nor rgyas dkar po/ lhor padma dkar po/ nub tu karko ṭa sngon po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ byang shar du padma chen po dkar po/ shar lho dung skyong ser po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan dkar po/ nub byang du mtha' yas sngon po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod lha'i lus dang smad sprul 'jug can/ dbu la sprul mgo'i gdengs ga bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /klu de dag gi nam mkhar sprin brgyad ni/ shar du sgraugs pa/ lhor g.yo ba/ nub tu drag po/ byang du cher sgrogs pa/ byang shar du brtan pa/ shar lhor gang ba/ lho nub 'bebs pa/ nub byang du gtum pa ste thams cad kyang glog 'phreng 'khyud cing 'brug sgra sgrogs pa/ ser pa dang char 'bebs pa'o/ /dur khrod der gnas pa'i ri brgyad ni/ shar du rin po che'i lhun po/ lhor ma la ya ser po/ nub tu ke la shar dkar po/ byang du manda ra ljang khu/ byang shar du dbang chen nag po/ shar lhor spos ngad ldan ser po/ lho nub tu gangs can dkar po/ nub byang du dpal ri sngon po'o/ /ri de dag la gnas pa'i mchod rten brgyad ni/ shar du rdo rje dkar po/ lhor rdo rje nag po/ nub tu rdo rje chags pa dkar po/ byang du rdo rje 'dus byas ser po/ byang shar du rdo rje thugs dkar po/ shar lhor sku rdo rje dmar po/ lho nub tu rin po che'i rdo rje nag po/ nub byang du chos rdo rje ljang khu'o/ /zhes pa bzhin nam/ yang na brgyad po byang chub mchod rten gyi rnam pa can no/

/gzhan yang*/ keng rus dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa'i ro dang*/ shing la dpyangs pa sogs mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /sngar bshad pa de dag gi mtshon don rags pa ni/ de yang gzhal yas khang rnam snang las bskyed pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gzugs phung rnam par dag pa rnam snang gi ngo bor mos pa de mtshon/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pas ni/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi de kho na nyid mi mnyam pa med pa dang*/ sgo bzhis ni rim pa bzhin du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ yang dag pa spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa mtshon/ rta babs kyis bsam gtan bzhi/ mchod pa'i lha mos ting nge 'dzin bzhi/ rin po che'i rgyan sogs kyis ni gdul bya'i re ba skong ba/ dril chung gi sgras gdul bya la chos ston pa/ nang gi rdo rje'i 'phreng ba zlum pos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs dang*/ dur khrod kyis bdag med pa dang*/ keng rus sogs kyis mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mtshon/ chu rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems/ klu rnams kyis phar phyin/ shing rnams kyis rtsa mes gtum mo/ sprin gyis byang sems dkar po/ mchod rten rnams kyis sku gsum gyi go 'phang*/ grub thob kyis de mngon du byed pa'i gang zag mtshon pa sogs yin no/ /gnyis pa bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i lam khyer rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa la gnyis/ gdan bskyed pa dang*/ dngos so/ /dang po ni/ re mig gru bzhi pa'i dbus su yaṃ sngon po zhig thol gyis byung ba 'od du mer gyis zhu nas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog nag la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can dbyibs zlum po drag tu g.yo bzhin pa zhig tu gyur/ rlung dkyil de'i steng dang*/ nang gi shar ma gtogs pa'i phyogs gzhan gsum dang*/ sgo bzhi'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang*/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan bcas zung re re/ nang gi shar gyi re mig gi nang dang re mig gi phyi nang g-i grwa bzhir sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan zung 'brel re re bsam mo/

/'dir rlung dkyil de kha dog nag pas ni mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa mtshon zhing*/ cung zad dmar bas gtum mo'ang mtshon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phen pa sngon du btang nas/ gdan dbus ma nyi dkyil gyi steng du dbyangs ky-i a gnyis kyi dang po a thung ser po zhig byung de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ steng ngos su 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba zhig la nga rgyal bzhag de'i steng du chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar byung ba'i dhīḥyig ser po sgra ldan 'od zer 'bar ba la sems bzung*/ dhīḥyongs su gyur pa las gser gy-i rdo rje phyed pa'i yu ba can gyi ral gri sngon po so gnyis ma'i rnam pa can gyi yu ba'i lte ba'am/ ral gri'i rtsa ba'i dbus su dhīḥser pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/

gshegs pa lnga/ gshegs ma lnga/ sems dpa' bcu drugasems ma bzhi/ khro bo bcu sogs kyi ngo bor gyur pa thams cad 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i rnam pa can/ shar dang shar lho pa/ lho dang lho nub pa/ nub dang nub byang ba/ byang dang byang shar ba steng phyogs ba rnams rim pa bzhin du/ sku mdog ni sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba ste phyag g.yas rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje rin po che padma ral gri 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon thams cad na po ti 'dzin pa'i rnam par spyan drangs ral gri la thim pas/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas glegs bam thugs kar 'dzin pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis sprul pa shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi rang bzhin can 'ja' tshon ltar dwangs shing gsal ba zhig la nga rgyal 'jog go /de ltar bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ gzhi dang rnam pa mthun tshul yod de/ gzhi la 'dzam bu'i gling gi mngal skyes khams drug ldan zhig gis 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byas nas/ 'od gsal de las langs pa dang dus mnyam du 'od gsal de'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung 'od zer lnga pas nyer len dang sems kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas te/ dngos gnas la rlung sems tsam las dbang po kun tshang ba'i bar do'i lus 'grub pa dang rnam pa mthun par rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mos pas bskyed pa yin pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor 'di la bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gzhi la 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi mngal skyes zhig gis 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byas pa'i mthar bar do'i lus 'grub pa dang chos mthun pas sgrub pa po rang nyid la 'byung 'gyur gyi bar do sbyong bar byed/

rdzogs rim gyi skabs su dpe don gyi 'od gsal gnyis las sgyu ma'i sku gnyis 'grub pa dang rnam pa mthun zhing*/ de'i dge rtsa smin byed du 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bras dus kyi longs sku dngos dang rnam pa mthun zhing*/ de da lta nas lam phyed kyi tshul du bsgoms pas sku de 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu rdor 'dzin bskyed pa 'di sbyang gzhi bar do dang chos mthun pa yang yin te/ re mig gi dbus kyi rlung de/ 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ a yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi sems dang*/ dhīḥyig ser po bar do'i ngag dang*/ ral gri de ni bar do'i yid dang*/ de las 'od zer 'phros te bde bar gshegs pa sogs spyan drangs pa sogs bar do'i bya ba dang*/ de rnams las 'jam dpal du gyur pa ni bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum cig car du grub pa dang chos mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /de bskyed pa ni/ sbyong byed lam gyi skabs dang chos mthun te/ re mig gi dbus kyi rlung de sgyu lus gnyis kyi sgru gzhir gyur pa'i 'od gsal gnyis kyi bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ a las byung ba'i zla ba de 'od gsal gnyis kyi sems dang*/ zla ba'i dbus kyi dhīḥni dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i sku gnyis kyi gsung dang*/ ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa ni sku de gnyis kyi thugs dang*/ de las 'od zer 'phros bde bar gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs pa ni sku de gnyis kyi mdzad pa dang*/ de gnyis las 'jam dpal du gyur ba ni 'od gsal gnyis las sku de gnyis 'grub pa dang rnam pa mthun zhing*/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa skye ba'i dge rtsa smin byed du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bskyed pa ni/ 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang chos mthun te/ re mig gi rlung de mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi dngos rgyur gyur pa'i rlung dang*/ a yig las byung ba'i zla ba de zung 'jug gi sku de'i dngos rgyu don gyi 'od gsal dang*/
